# Debian trixie packages every CI job needs: GNU R 4.5.0 (the oracle the
# corpora were recorded with), a C toolchain for natives and R CMD SHLIB,
# and the tools the harnesses call. Read by the CI image (Dockerfile) and by
# .github/actions/setup when a job runs without the image.
r-base-core=4.5.0-3
r-base-dev
build-essential
python3
curl
ca-certificates
git
gh
valgrind
xz-utils
libcurl4-openssl-dev
zlib1g-dev
libcairo2-dev
libpango1.0-dev
libpng-dev
libjpeg-dev
libtiff-dev
